title: 은행 입출금 알림 읽기: 얼마가 들어오고 나갔어요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean bank deposit or withdrawal alert and find how much money came in or went out, who or what it was for, and how much is left.
summary: Learners read short bank text alerts and find the amount, the type of transaction, the person or purpose, and the balance.
note: The bank name, account number, people's names, and amounts in this worksheet are made up for practice.

task.title: Read the bank alerts
task.line: Read each alert or sentence, then write the answer in Korean or in numbers.

sections.heading: Sample alerts: one account, two days

items.text: The money left in your account after this transaction.
Money was sent from one account to another account.
A bill is paid from your account on the same day every month.
The account the money comes into or goes out of. Part of the number is often hidden with *.
Extra money the bank takes for a service.
items.example: 다른 은행 ATM을 쓰면 수수료가 붙을 수 있어요.

items.text: When you pay with it, the money goes out of your account right away.
items.example: 체크카드로 계산하면 통장에서 바로 돈이 빠져나가요.

sections.heading: How to read an alert
paragraphs: Read from top to bottom: bank name and date/time, then 입금 or 출금 with the amount, then a name or a purpose, and 잔액 last. After 입금, the name is usually the person or company that sent the money. After 출금, it is the person who got the money or what you paid for.
To check an alert, use 잔액. For 입금, the old balance plus the amount should equal the new 잔액. For 출금, the old balance minus the amount should equal it.

exercises: Read the alert and answer: [새봄은행] 10/15 13:20 / 123-***-456789 / 입금 30,000원 / 박지영 / 잔액 415,000원 ① 얼마가 들어왔어요? ② 누가 보냈어요? ③ 지금 잔액은 얼마예요?
Write 입금 or 출금 for each situation: ① 회사에서 이번 달 월급이 들어왔어요. ② 편의점에서 체크카드로 우유를 샀어요. ③ 동생이 빌려 간 돈을 보내 줬어요.
Fill in each blank with 잔액, 수수료, or 자동이체: ① 돈을 쓰기 전에 앱에서 ____을 확인해요. ② 편의점 ATM에서 돈을 찾았는데 ____가 나왔어요. ③ 요금 내는 날을 자꾸 잊어버리면 ____를 신청하세요.
Read the alert and answer: [새봄은행] 10/20 11:47 / 123-***-456789 / 출금 120,000원 / 이민호 / 잔액 80,000원 ① 이 돈은 들어왔어요, 나갔어요? ② 이 돈을 받은 사람은 누구예요? ③ 이 출금 전에는 잔액이 얼마였어요?
Read the alert and answer in one Korean sentence: [새봄은행] 11/01 07:00 / 123-***-456789 / 출금 15,900원 / 자동이체 인터넷요금 / 잔액 523,100원 — 무슨 돈이 어떻게 나갔어요?
answers: ① 입금 ② 출금 ③ 입금
① 잔액 ② 수수료 ③ 자동이체
인터넷 요금이 자동이체로 나갔어요. (인터넷 요금 15,900원이 자동이체로 나갔어요.)
